freeze_rule: Do not record a raw-file checksum until the exact downloaded bytes have been materialized and inspected.
join_rule: Freeze plant and pollinator crosswalks before inspecting the focal rewiring contrasts.
analysis_rule: The 18-network source supplies the preferred response surface; the trait workbook supplies conventional filters. Neither source alone supplies independent decision-equivalence classes.

acquisition_policy.anonymous_metadata: required and sufficient for source discovery, file IDs, declared sizes and published digests
acquisition_policy.published_bytes: materialize only through an authenticated Dryad download route or a verified public institutional mirror
acquisition_policy.dryad_token_secret: optional repository secret DRYAD_TOKEN; absence must not fail metadata smoke
acquisition_policy.no_credential_fallback: record metadata_only_bytes_unavailable and retain source manifests
acquisition_policy.analysis_gate: no response modelling until exact source bytes are materialized and checksummed

implementation.workflow_behavior: metadata-first; token-aware; uploads inventory even when bytes are unavailable

next_materialization_gate: Provide an authenticated Dryad byte route or an exact verified mirror; then require local SHA-256 to match the published Dryad digest before any response analysis.
